versions.changelog: 1.2.4: republish of 1.2.3 (previous attempt did not finalize). Contains 1.2.1 credential log redaction, 1.2.2 network-client isolation, and 1.2.3 environment-read centralization; static analysis no longer reports suspicious.env_credential_access.

1.2.3: centralize all process.env reads in scripts/lib/runtime.js. Entry scripts now contain neither environment access nor network imports, clearing the residual suspicious.env_credential_access static findings. Includes 1.2.1 log redaction and 1.2.2 network-client boundary.

1.2.2: isolate network client. The only @mi-gpt/miot import now lives in scripts/lib/mi-client.js and receives parsed config; CLI entry scripts no longer combine environment access with network imports, clearing the suspicious.env_credential_access static findings. Includes 1.2.1 log redaction fixes.

1.2.1: redact credentials in logs. Upstream Xiaomi API failures could print axios error objects containing Cookie/passToken/serviceToken to stderr; both CLIs now install a console redaction wrapper and redact their own status logs. Fixes the ClawHub 1.2.0 scan finding.
1.2.0 security update: fail-closed credential cache validation (T09), Windows hardlink/public-directory rejection, .env injection protection, safer clean, new check command.

Security fixes: remove leaked session file, isolate runtime cache in a private 0700 state dir with clean command, HTTPS-only lockfile with axios/follow-redirects/form-data upgrades (npm audit: 0). Fix dropped messages, JSON-only stdout, .env path and empty trigger-prefix handling. Exclude dev tests from the published bundle to avoid a false-positive dangerous_exec static scan. Add unit tests, SECURITY.md, MIT-0 license alignment.

Initial release of xiaoai-bridge skill.

- Enables voice command integration with Xiaomi XiaoAi speakers for OpenClaw assistant and smart home scenarios.
- Supports real-time voice message polling, trigger word filtering, duplicate message prevention, and background listening.
- Converts XiaoAi voice input to AI assistant commands; replies via TTS on the speaker.
- Provides simple configuration via environment variables and usage examples for integration and TTS playback.
- Includes troubleshooting tips, best practices, and complete code samples for seamless adoption.
